failList.defect: Lexical import resolution still loses the type behind an enclosing using alias. A file alias OS = System.OperatingSystem followed inside a namespace by using static OS makes the actual scanner miss IsWindows(). The same enclosing alias followed by using Host = OS makes it miss Host.IsWindows(). Both are valid, compiled C# in one file. ScopeFor stores the rightmost token OS rather than the resolved OperatingSystem type, and TypeName follows only one alias edge. Each probe expects one os-check and receives zero. This is within the promised same-file alias/static-import coverage, not a cross-file helper, reflection, or global-using limitation.
